content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

About 1.6 to 2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day is the evidence-based range for building muscle. Most people do well around 1.6 to 2.0 g/kg. Going above 2.2 g/kg hasn't been shown to add more.

💡 For example, at 75 kg that's roughly 120 to 165 g a day. Spread it over 3 to 5 meals, with about 25 to 40 g each. Total daily intake matters more than exact timing.

If you tell me your body weight, I can work out your daily target.
